description: Cs₄Na₂ScGaF₁₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve F atoms to form distorted CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with nine CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with three equivalent GaF₆ octahedra, faces with seven CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with three equivalent ScF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.14-3.40 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded to twelve F atoms to form distorted CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with nine CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, faces with seven CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one ScF₆ octahedra, faces with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and faces with three equivalent GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 1°. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.11-3.24 Å. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with three equivalent ScF₆ octahedra, faces with seven CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, and  a faceface with one GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. There are three shorter (2.21 Å) and three longer (2.34 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Sc is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form ScF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and faces with eight CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. All Sc-F bond lengths are 2.03 Å. Ga is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form GaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. All Ga-F bond lengths are 1.91 Å. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Ga atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one Sc atom.
